rows.grounds: compound referring to aṃ, āṃ and the ka class of syllables

rows.lemma: [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ aṃ āṃ kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ tārāyai namaḥ brahmarandhre, hrīṃḥ trīṃ huṃ iṃ īṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ ugrāyai namaḥ lalāṭe, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ uṃ ūṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ mahogrāyai namo bhruvoḥ, agrepyevaṃ jñeyam || ]
rows.grounds: embedded mantra sequence specifying bījas, syllables, deities, and locations
